description: This header provides utilities for testing exception safety, including classes, functions, and macros to simulate exceptions, track object lifetimes, and verify exception safety guarantees in C++ code.

classes.name: TestException
classes.description: A simple exception class for testing exception throwing.

classes.name: TestBadAllocException
classes.description: A custom exception class derived from std::bad_alloc and TestException for testing allocation failures.

classes.name: ConstructorTracker
classes.description: Tracks object constructions and destructions to detect leaks and re-constructs.

classes.name: TrackedObject
classes.description: Base class for objects whose lifetime is tracked by ConstructorTracker.

classes.name: ThrowingBool
classes.description: A convertible-to-bool class that can throw exceptions at controlled times.

classes.name: ExceptionSafetyTest
classes.description: Performs exception safety testing on objects of type T, verifying guarantees via contracts.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Bitwise OR operator for TypeSpec and AllocSpec enums.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Bitwise AND operator for TypeSpec and AllocSpec enums.

methods.name: GetSpecString
methods.description: Returns string representation of TypeSpec or AllocSpec.

methods.name: MaybeThrow
methods.description: Simulates throwing an exception based on internal logic.

methods.name: FailureMessage
methods.description: Generates failure message for exception test assertions.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Sets a countdown value for exception simulation.

methods.name: UnsetCountdown
methods.description: Resets the countdown to disable exception simulation.
